name: Step -Futari no Kankei wa Ippo Zutsu-
original_name: STEP ―二人の関係は一歩ずつ―
source: Akino Minori returns to her hometown after her parents went abroad due to work. She was supposed to live with her grandparents, but they are on a long trip, so she starts living with her uncle, Kouta. She meets her childhood friends Yuu and Mizuho. Her romantic life now begins.
translation: Akino Minori returns to her hometown after her parents went abroad due to work. She was supposed to live with her grandparents, but they are on a long trip, so she starts living with her uncle, Kouta. She meets her childhood friends Yuu and Mizuho. Her romantic life now begins.
